name: Ukugawula nge-router
job.name: Ukugawula
intro: Gawula izinhlangothi ze-V, gxoba imigqa, noma gawula isithombe njengesikhala esiphakeme, bese uhlola uhlelo bese uluthumela ku-router yakho. Isiqalo nje: hlala uqale ngokugijima ngaphandle kwezinto (air-cut) ukuhamba kokuqala bese uhlola uhlelo nomshini wakho.
host.none: Lolu hlelo alunalo udwebo lokufunda izimo kulo.
mode.vcarve.note: Izinhlangothi ezivaliwe (izinhlamvu, amalogo): i-V-bit ilandela phakathi kwesimo ngasinye, ijule njengoba ibanzi, ukuze izindonga zihlangane nomphetho ngokuphelele. Izimbobo yizimo ezisemkhatsini wezimo.
mode.engrave.note: Landela imigqa nezinhlangothi ngokujula, ngokudlula kanye noma ngaphezu kwesisodwa. Umugqa we-V-bit ubanzi njengoba ujule.
mode.relief.note: Isithombe esingwevu siba yisithombe se-3D esiphakeme: okumhlophe kuhlala phezulu, okumnyama kugawulwa ujule ngokuphelele. Umbuli ulandela indawo ngaphandle kokugawula ngaphakathi kuyo.
post.note: Umbhalo umshini wakho odinga ozungeze ukugawula. {rpm} {tool} {name} {safe} {feed} {unit} ziyagcwaliswa. Izinguquko zakho ziyagcinwa kulolu hlobo.
cad.draw.label: Dweba izindlela zokugawula
cad.erase.label: Susa izindlela zokugawula
r.flatno: akukho: zonke izingxenye zincane ngokwanele ibhithi le-V yodwa
r.cellv: {p} mm ngephikseli yesithombe, {step} mm phakathi kwemigqa.
carve.warn.floor: Isisekelo esilingene sishiyiwe: khetha i-flat mill noma i-V-bit ukusihlanza.
carve.warn.narrowfloor: Isisekelo esilingene simncane kune-flat mill: i-V-bit iyasigcoba, kodwa akukho okuhlanzwa kuqala.
preview.alt: Ibhulokhi njengoba izindlela zokugawula zingayigawula, ijulile kakhulu ngokwemnyama
preview.note: Ukubukeka kwebhulokhi egawuliwe, ijulile kakhulu ngokwemnyama (ikhombisa ukwakheka kwebhithi, hhayi umshini).
check.nofeed: Inyathelo lokugawula lifika ngaphambi kokuthi kusethwe isivinini sokudla.
check.nospindle: Ukugawula kwenza ngaphansi kwephezulu kanti i-spindle ayikaqali.
check.rapidcut: Inyathelo elisheshayo liwela ukugawula ngaphansi kophezulu.
check.nounit: Uhlelo aluthi lutshele ukuthi yimamilimitha noma amayintshi.
check.note: Ukuhlola kufunda i-G-code bese kubheka okungabhidliza umsebenzi noma okungachitha. Akwazi umshini wakho: hlala uqale ngokugijima ngaphandle kwezinto.
carve.err.noshape: Akukho simo esivaliwe sokugawula. Dweba noma khetha izinhlangothi ezivaliwe.
carve.err.manypasses: Ukuhlanza isisekelo nge-V-bit kungathatha ukudlula okungaphezu kwenani elithi: {count}. Sebenzisa i-flat mill, noma shiya isisekelo.
carve.err.big: Isimo sikhulu kakhulu kulo mkhiqizo. Gawula ngezingxenye.
cmd.carve.help: Yenza izindlela zokugawula kusukela ezimweni ngezilungiselelo zephaneli.
cmd.carvegcode.help: Yenza izindlela zokugawula uphinde ulande i-G-code.
cmd.gcode.done: I-G-code ilandiwe: imisebenzi {ops}, imigqa {lines}, cishe {minutes} min.
